implementation: Original Evidence Lens photometric optimization; degree-zero diffuse linear RGB, black compositing, displayed sRGB full-grid mean L1 loss.

initialization.quaternion: independent normalized standard normals in wxyz order

optimization.source_sampling: address registered ordered list cyclically once per step
optimization.topology: fixed; no densification, pruning or merging
optimization.production_freeze: Separate recorder decision after both train pilots, before formal production. Each admitted condition gets exactly identical aggregate source pixels and optimizer steps.

render.depth: foreground-opacity-normalized camera-Z metres; NaN when alpha=0 or nonpositive/nonfinite

failure: nonfinite gradient, parameter, loss or RGB
no source-specific nonzero geometry or colour gradient
wrong final topology or step count

rights.third_party: gsplat v1.5.3 under its upstream Apache-2.0 distribution
rights.training_inputs: only the authorized original source RGB and their own native calibration
